structured_output.title: Cert-manager namespace flag behavior fix may apply
structured_output.content: This fix targets cert-manager deployments running with the `--namespace=<namespace>` flag to restrict scope to a single namespace. Your environment has cert-manager v1.17.0 installed with `global.leaderElection.namespace` configured in values. Check whether your cert-manager Deployment spec includes `--namespace=<namespace>` as a command-line argument; if present, this fix applies to your upgrade and may change cluster-scoped controller behavior.
